name: wow-locker
description: WoW Classic character tracker (Hardcore-friendly) — PWA with push notifications

scripts.dev:pwa: bun run --filter @wow-locker/web build && bun run --filter @wow-locker/api start
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && luajit addon/test/sim.lua
scripts.prepare: husky && ([ -n "$CI" ] || bun "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../../addon-kit/hooks.ts" install . >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "prepare: the family's git hooks not installed (bun addon-kit/hooks.ts install wow-locker)" >&2)
